name: runlease
description: Leased spot machines for coding agents, in your own cloud: skills, slash commands, typed tools and a live view of what is running.

pane.title: Runlease pane
pane.description: auto opens the pane when this session launches a machine, on a wide terminal; command opens it only with /runlease; off turns the pane and its command off.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before a lease ends (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: A lease with less than this left shows a band above the prompt, with buttons to add time.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the machine list is read from this computer. It makes no cloud call. Never faster than every 10 seconds.

notify.title: Notify before a lease ends
notify.description: Raise a desktop notification when a lease is about to end, as well as a toast.
